system.description:
• Effect: Constrain a target (it is Restrained and unable to act) for rounds equal to its Level, and succeed on a Charisma check (d20 + Charisma modifier) against DC = 8 + the target's Level. If successful: read their full state of mind; detect alignment; pierce illusions and disguises; read surface thoughts and deep memories; detect charm and enchantment effects.
  • May then attempt an exorcism — target makes a Will save against your Class Save DC, or succumbs
  • Inherently evil creatures (demons, vampires, devils) are destroyed; lycanthropes are cured; undead gain eternal rest or are destroyed if they were evil in life
  • Any creature that resists expels the Paladin from its mind and can never be targeted again
  • The Paladin must rest immediately after for 1 hour per Level of the creature — bedridden and helpless during this time

activities.name: Read Soul
activities.text: Against DC 8 + the restrained target's Level; on success read its mind, alignment, illusions and enchantments.

activities.name: Exorcism
activities.text: The target saves or succumbs: evil outsiders are destroyed, lycanthropes cured and undead laid to rest.
